title: LMOD: A Large Multimodal Ophthalmology Dataset and Benchmark for Large Vision-Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating and comparing the predictive accuracy of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) on diagnostic tasks across different age groups (18-40, 40-60, 60+) and calculating statistical significance (p-values) to identify performance disparities.

Evaluating and comparing the predictive accuracy of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) on diagnostic tasks across different gender categories (male, female) and calculating statistical significance (p-values) to identify performance disparities.
